Description: Full functional feature name as it appears in the output CSV.
The low-level descriptor from which the functional feature is derived.
Acoustic category grouping the LLD by the signal property it captures (Prosodic | Spectral | Cepstral | Sound Quality)

Readable description of the acoustic or perceptual property the LLD measures on a per-frame basis. Definitions from "Association Between Acoustic Features and Neuropsychological Test Performance in the Framingham Heart Study: Observational Study".
Name of the statistical aggregation applied to the LLD time series to produce one value per segment.
Description of the statistical operation performed over all frames in the segment. Definitions from https://audeering.github.io/opensmile/_components/.
Signal processing steps applied to the raw LLD before the functional is computed encoded as a short token (sma | de | sma_de | none).

Description of the processing transformation applied to the LLD frames prior to aggregation. Definitions have been adapted from https://audeering.github.io/opensmile/_components/cContourSmoother.html and https://audeering.github.io/opensmile/_components/cDeltaRegression.html
